data.title: 克洛伊 · 爱因兹贝伦的偷跑花嫁
data.description: 【雪原别馆玻璃回廊·午后】克洛伊穿着轻盈的白粉婚纱，手里抱着被她偷偷塞满糖果的捧花；她把头纱掀到一侧，棕色肌肤在雪光里闪耀，橙色眼睛带着“这场仪式先从甜点开始”的恶作剧笑。
data.action: 玻璃回廊里掀头纱展示糖果捧花，带着恶作剧笑邀请镜头保守秘密
data.lighting: crisp afternoon snowlight through the glass
data.mood: 把花嫁仪式变成甜点恶作剧
data.promptProse: Chloe von Einzbern from Fate wears a white-and-pink bridal dress with a short veil, rose ribbons and a candy-filled bouquet. She von Einzbern lifts her short veil to reveal the candy hidden inside her bouquet. She leans against the glass corridor with a conspiratorial grin, warm brown skin glowing against the snow while her orange eyes invite the viewer to share the secret before the ceremony begins. crisp afternoon snowlight through the glass.
